messages:
Anna: Quick FYI — scheduling a Terraform apply for hotfix v1.2.1 in ~15m. Branch: release/hotfix-1.2.1. Need branch pin + KMS key freeze before main apply. Ill attach release notes to the PR and run a canary in us-west-2 first.

DeployBot: :alarm_clock: TF plan queued: workspace `prod-network-canary` -> `prod-network`. Plan ID pb-20260321-02. Auto-abort if >5% resource failures. Logs: https://deploy.internal/reports/pb-20260321-02

Mike: Reminder: providers.tf must have explicit pins. Last time a minor provider bump caused diff churn. Example snippet:```provider "aws" { version = "~> 4.60" region = var.region }``` Also prefer module refs pinned to commit SHAs.

Sara: Note: this change removes legacy role `svc-legacy-admin`. If destroyed, we need to rebind service accounts before traffic shift. Canary only in us-west-2 to validate bindings.

Anna: Canary run will be manual. Holding main apply for +3m after canary success to watch telemetry.

Leo: Ops-oncall will monitor infra metrics. If DeployBot posts `apply.error` with TF-ERR-RESOURCE, follow /playbooks/infra-rollback.md and create #incidents ticket.

ops-oncall: On pager. Abort criteria: inference-gateway p95 >200ms for 5m OR error rate >2x baseline. Ill post a timestamped abort message before action.

DeployBot: Branch lock set on `release/hotfix-1.2.1`. To abort manually: `deploybot abort 3087654321` (authorized: @Anna, @Mike).

Sara: Preflight: run tfstate backup and snapshot tagging: `./scripts/tfstate-backup.sh prod-network rel-1.2.1` tag `rel-1.2.1-snap`.

Anna: Short plan excerpt: ```~ aws_iam_role.svc-app (in-place update) - aws_iam_role.svc-legacy-admin (destroy) ~ aws_route_table.rtb-ingress (replacement)``` If route table wants replacement, HOLD and escalate.

Mike: ACK. If rtb-ingress shows replacement, do not promote. We'll run a revert dry-run and notify infra-sig. We had a cascade last quarter, so be conservative.

ops-oncall: :thumbsup: SRE alerted, will standby.

DeployBot: Canary apply started (pb-20260321-02). Streaming: https://deploy.internal/reports/pb-20260321-02/status

Anna: Posting canary verdict in ~10m. If clean, will unhold and trigger prod apply.

Mike: If anything odd, Ill push immediate provider rollback and ring infra-sig.

Sara: Added migration steps and manual bind commands to PR under Release Notes -> Migration.

DeployBot: Canary complete: apply.success for pb-20260321-02. No IAM destroys in canary. Will wait 5m then promote.

ops-oncall: Monitoring dashboards now. Standby for abort signal.
